firewall_controls.rule: Only explicitly registered API_OUTPUT fields may serialize
Mobile app role has no USAGE/SELECT on engine_internal; client_render only
RLS limits every user-scoped public row to authenticated subject
No 219-state vector, covariance, raw pools, damage, mechanistic fluxes, weights or calibrated thresholds
Action/copy generated only after safety gate; empty safe set returns no recommendation
No VETO rule IDs, conditions, thresholds or per-action results in payload/log/analytics
Missing freshness, confidence, provenance, source quality or safety receipt cannot be treated as pass
Mobile renders last verified signed DTO only; it does not compute physiology
No diagnosis, disease prediction, medication/dose instruction or medical-lab interpretation
Only CELL01–CELL03 bounded support fractions cross; raw QSSA values remain hidden
Spectral HRV only from quality-controlled beat-to-beat NN/RR data; RMSSD fallback otherwise
Route context, message text, decision IDs and health inputs are minimized/redacted
Every public payload carries lineage/version/freshness/coverage metadata
All physiology, safety, scoring, projection, ranking, forecast and personalization computation executes only in trusted engine_compute; outputs are materialized and signed
Presentation API may authorize, select, redact, schema-validate and serialize signed client_render DTOs; it must not implement or recreate proprietary/derived-health computation
Mobile bundle contains no model, equation, coefficient, weight, threshold, rule, VETO table, nutrient matrix, derived-health algorithm or fallback inference

gaps.evidence: v39w Twin 05 API Contracts!C5:C7 | 12 Firewall & QA!A25:B25
gaps.decision: Forbid the complete 12-vector, weights and damage values; explicitly allow only selected projected cluster scores under T02/T03.

gaps.finding: Curve payload has y values but no x/timestamp coordinate.
gaps.evidence: 05 API Contracts!C8 | 06 Backend Binding!A13:D13

gaps.evidence: 02 Tier Contract!E14 | 12 Firewall & QA!A7 | 05 API Contracts!C8:C9

gaps.finding: Band vocabulary and state-label vocabulary coexist without a formal mapping; gauge band values are unspecified.
gaps.evidence: 06 Backend Binding!A7:B8 | 05 API Contracts!C12

gaps.finding: Curve normalization guarantees 0-100 but multi-meal superposition can exceed a single-meal peak; peak definition/clipping is absent.
gaps.evidence: 04 Engine Binding!A19:C22 | 06 Backend Binding!A13:B14

gaps.evidence: 08 Cards — Core TW!A1:J114 | 09 Cards — Dashboard!A1:I72 | 10 Cards — MS + Muscle!A1:H56

gaps.finding: Cross-navigation claims no health value in route/telemetry while clusterId/actionId reveal a wellness context.
gaps.evidence: 05 API Contracts!C18:C24 | 12 Firewall & QA!A11:B11
gaps.decision: Treat context IDs as sensitive; keep first-party, minimize persistence and redact from third-party analytics.

gaps.finding: The source cites v39s/v39sEng sheet counts and filenames as if current; these require reconciliation against the newly attached master.
gaps.evidence: 00 START!A6:C8 | 04 Engine Binding!A2

gaps.finding: Worked trace is static: workbook has zero formulas even though it says every number is computed and reproducible.

gaps.finding: The PDF state-map table has cramped/overlapping index and count columns, and sheet 11 acceptance text is visibly clipped.
gaps.evidence: Twin PDF page 2 | 11 Worked Trace!B27

gaps.finding: T12 claims live-verified evidence, but the Twin workbook contains no actual PMID, evidence record or verification timestamp.
gaps.evidence: 04 Engine Binding!A31:E31 | 05 API Contracts!C13 | 12 Firewall & QA!A29:B29
gaps.decision: Bind T12 to a concrete evidence registry containing claim ID, PMID/DOI/URL, verifiedAt, retraction status, evidence tier/version and approval state.

gaps.finding: There is no physical database contract: no entity/table names, primary/foreign keys, required/nullability rules, retention, indexes or row-level tenant policy.
gaps.evidence: All 15 sheets; especially 05 API Contracts and 06 Backend Binding
gaps.decision: Use this UI specification only as input to a normalized signal dictionary and database/API schema; do not scrape arbitrary workbook cells at runtime.

gaps.finding: T07 exposes energy.inKcal while the firewall says raw intakes never reach the screen.
gaps.evidence: 05 API Contracts!C11 | 12 Firewall & QA!A8:B8
gaps.decision: Clarify that a daily aggregate kcal estimate may cross, while raw food/nutrient events and thresholds remain hidden; name it aggregateIntakeKcal and attach quality/freshness.

gaps.finding: The 68 dashboard, 12 Mood-Stress and 36 Muscle card rows have no complete delivery/selection API contract.
gaps.evidence: 09 Cards — Dashboard!A5:F72 | 10 Cards — MS + Muscle!A5:E56 | 05 API Contracts!C5:C13
gaps.decision: Define card-selection output(s), priority/order, maximum count, render policy, catalog version, locale, dismissal/expiry and typed link from resolver state to approved card id.

gaps.finding: The fourth Renewal cycle has no admitted client projection. The main UI_133 and ATLAS-001 contracts expose exactly three CELL supports. The Atlas workbook names a one-carbon source but defines no bounded renewal-support formula, calibration, uncertainty, availability gate or field addition.
gaps.evidence: A07/A08 cannot honestly return four comparable cycle supports.
gaps.decision: Do not create a fourth score. Serve three admitted numeric cycles; an optional Renewal shell is typed unavailable with no support/band/speed/trend/limiter values until a new projection is calibrated and admitted.

gaps.finding: Cofactor bindings are false for CoQ10 and betaine. Neither is one of P1 Nutrients 81; both are overlay/supplement inputs in the attached v39v main. Atlas sheet 08 claims every cofactor adequacy comes from P1 Nutrients 81.
gaps.evidence: The limiter can request nonexistent signals or silently substitute wrong data.
gaps.decision: Bind CoQ10 and betaine to the governed supplement/overlay registry with explicit availability, provenance and uncertainty; never index them as canonical nutrients.

gaps.finding: The displayed cofactor sets do not match all modeled inputs. ATP QSSA uses CoQ10/Mg/Fe while Atlas adds aggregated B-vitamins without an aggregation rule. GSH modeling includes glutamate but Atlas omits it. One-carbon input includes methionine and potentially riboflavin while Atlas omits them.
gaps.evidence: The claimed Liebig argmin may not actually set the cycle support ceiling.
gaps.decision: Create a versioned cycle-cofactor binding table with stable IDs, aggregation formula, inclusion rationale, missingness behavior and a test that limiter membership matches the production model.

gaps.finding: Atlas repeatedly states 15 TVMCD pathways feed both taxonomies, but the active organ mapping contains only D1-D13. The main explicitly marks D14 and D15 GLOBAL_MODIFIER_PENDING with no organ consumer.
gaps.evidence: System scores and connected-pathway UI may imply unsupported D14/D15 organ effects.
gaps.decision: Expose machine-visible mapping status; fail closed for D14/D15 until a cited versioned organ map is admitted.

gaps.finding: The PMID registry's system rows still use a C-id column with C1-C12 values, violating the workbook's own SYS-only organ namespace rule.
gaps.evidence: A taxonomy collision can route science or system cards to the wrong entity family.
gaps.decision: Replace with SYS1-SYS12 and enforce typed namespace IDs in contract tests.

gaps.finding: The Atlas source says SYS1-SYS12, while the attached main organ mapping rows and output keys still use O1-O12. No explicit O-to-SYS translation contract is present.
gaps.evidence: Backend joins and endpoint IDs can diverge.
gaps.decision: Choose one canonical API namespace (SYS recommended), maintain a versioned internal alias map, and reject bare O/C IDs at the API boundary.

gaps.finding: All 159 user-facing strings remain DRAFT; all 477 Founder/Regulatory/Clinical checks are unchecked.
gaps.evidence: No card or copy asset is approved for production.
gaps.decision: Add versioned approval records with approver, role, timestamp and hash; boolean glyphs are not sufficient release evidence.

gaps.finding: The API omits freshness, as-of, stale, model/catalog version, availability, confidence, quality and provenance metadata although screen specs require cached views and stamps and the main projection contract requires confidence.
gaps.evidence: v39w Atlas 05 API Contracts!A2; COMMON response envelope
gaps.decision: Add the shared metadata envelope listed in this audit to every endpoint.

gaps.finding: Trend points contain y/usualLo/usualHi but no timestamp. The workbook alternates between a 14-day trend, 30-day histories and a 90-day support history without endpoint/window semantics.
gaps.evidence: Time-series order, timezone, resampling and chart windows are not implementable reliably.
gaps.decision: Add ISO-8601 timestamps, timezone, sample cadence, window and aggregation method; provide separate or parameterized history contracts.

gaps.finding: Screen specs allow a 'gentle default' or 'gentle foods' when VETO empties the food list, and Foundation cards contain direct actionable food/supplement/daylight levers outside foods[].
gaps.evidence: Static copy can bypass VETO-first safety.
gaps.decision: When VETO returns no action, emit no recommendation. Any actionable lever embedded in copy must carry an actionId and pass the same VETO/ranking pipeline.

gaps.finding: C_score increases with damage Z_C if coefficient a is positive, but a, b, direction, per-cluster calibration and rounding are not specified.
gaps.evidence: A score could invert wellness meaning or band at boundaries.
gaps.decision: Lock the monotonic direction and coefficients, state whether banding uses raw or rounded score, and add endpoint monotonicity/boundary tests.

gaps.finding: Hallmark values are described as support/burden without a single locked direction.
gaps.evidence: The same numeric value could map to opposite canopy bands.
gaps.decision: Declare higher-is-better or higher-is-worse once, normalize before banding, and test every HM mapping.

gaps.finding: Share rules alternate between rejecting numeric fields and rejecting any digit-bearing field. Opaque IDs, URLs and asset references can legitimately contain digits.
gaps.evidence: Valid share requests may be rejected, or metric leakage checks may be incorrectly implemented.
gaps.decision: Use a strict allowlist of non-metric fields and deny numeric health/value keys; do not grep digits inside opaque identifiers.

gaps.finding: POST /share/compose does not distinguish request fields from response fields and lacks expiry, authorization, localization, idempotency and privacy semantics.
gaps.evidence: The endpoint cannot be implemented consistently or safely.
gaps.decision: Define separate request/response schemas and a short-lived non-identifying render token or server-generated asset.

gaps.finding: Inbound navigation carries clusterId to system or cell routes even though those routes require sysId or cycleId.
gaps.evidence: Ambiguous IDs can cross namespaces.
gaps.decision: Use a typed entityRef or route-specific parameters.

gaps.finding: science[], crossTalk[], connected[], feeding processes/nutrients and renderSeed have no complete schemas, ordering, nullability or stable identifier rules.
gaps.evidence: Different services and clients will infer incompatible shapes.
gaps.decision: Publish versioned JSON Schema/OpenAPI definitions with enums and examples.

gaps.finding: Tier-3 Foundation history and cofactor history are promised in the UI contract but absent from API contracts.
gaps.evidence: A04/A08/A09 Tier-3 screens cannot load their declared data.
gaps.decision: Add history endpoint(s) or query parameters with typed time-series points.

gaps.finding: Canopy Tier-2 dominant hallmark card is promised but no field or detail endpoint is defined.
gaps.evidence: Tap behavior cannot be wired.
gaps.decision: Add dominantCardId with source evidence, or a hallmark detail endpoint.

gaps.finding: PMIDs are explicitly unverified, and qa_pmid_live/OI-A2 incorrectly refer to sheet 10 rather than the actual sheet 13 registry.
gaps.evidence: The CI test can scan the wrong source and pass falsely.
gaps.decision: Point CI to a stable evidence registry ID rather than sheet ordinal and require live resolution plus claim-level relevance.

gaps.finding: API inventory says six endpoints, while build order says four endpoints plus share compose.
gaps.evidence: Planning and test coverage counts differ.
gaps.decision: Count concrete routes consistently; current specification has six route patterns.

gaps.finding: The Atlas package is anchored to a superseded 201-sheet v39sEng. The attached current engineer main identifies as v39v and contains 204 sheets.
gaps.evidence: Sheet bindings and invariants may drift silently.
gaps.decision: Re-anchor all bindings to the current workbook version/hash and store source sheet IDs, not only display names.

gaps.finding: The PDF names a different companion workbook filename than the attached workbook.
gaps.evidence: Document traceability is weaker.
gaps.decision: Use the exact artifact ID/hash in both files.

gaps.finding: Three rendered card sheets clip the guard-rule text around row 6; source values remain present.
gaps.evidence: Reviewers can miss a safety rule even though the cell data exists.
gaps.decision: Increase row height or wrap/resize in the next source revision.

gaps.topic: Plan PDF and Plan XLSX are different deliverables
gaps.finding: The PDF describes 14_08_26_SahaPlan_UI_Workbook_v1.xlsx with Sheet 02 Tier Contract, 03 Screen Specs, 04 Copy-Staged, 05 Interlocks, 06 ui_plan and 07 Backend Binding. The attached XLSX is a 13-sheet Engine Binding Specification v2.1 whose sheets 02-07 are Invariants & Bands, Engine Binding, VETO Gate, API Contracts, Data Objects and Parameters.
gaps.evidence: PlanUI PDF pages 1,4,7 | Plan XLSX 00 START!A9:D21
gaps.decision: Treat the PDF as evidence of a missing UI workbook, not as validation of the attached XLSX; require the referenced UI workbook or rebuild those missing contracts in the consolidated output.

gaps.topic: No declared SahaPlan API payload contract
gaps.finding: Plan Data Objects marks ui_plan as TO DECLARE, while the PDF says Sheet 06 already is the versioned ui_plan contract.
gaps.evidence: Plan 06 Data Objects!A19:E19 | Plan 10 Gaps & Decisions!A12:H12 | PlanUI PDF page 7
gaps.decision: Create one versioned client_render.ui_plan/public API signal registry with field-level exposure, type, unit, cadence, freshness, confidence, provenance and null/availability rules.

gaps.topic: Staged copy is not present or approved
gaps.finding: Pulse has 48 cluster cards and 24 PC strings, all marked DRAFT with unchecked sign-off cells; mood.ms12 override is blank. Plan PDF claims 63/76 draft strings on Sheet 04, but attached Plan Sheet 04 is VETO Gate and contains no copy catalog.
gaps.evidence: Pulse 08 Cards — Cluster 48!A4:H66 | Pulse 09 Copy — Staged PC!A4:H28 | Pulse 13 Corrections & Open!A10:F12 | PlanUI PDF pages 4-7 | Plan 04 VETO Gate
gaps.decision: Keep all copy/card responses non-production until catalog IDs, versions, translations and Founder/Regulatory/Clinical approvals are present; define crisis-routing copy separately.

gaps.finding: Pulse declares 133 UI scalars. Plan Data Objects names an existing ui_132 payload.
gaps.evidence: Pulse 07 Parameters!A4:E4 | Pulse PDF page 1 | Plan 06 Data Objects!A11:E11
gaps.decision: Cross-check the attached main master and rename/version the canonical projection payload; never encode the count in the table name.

gaps.topic: Pulse 133-scalar payload claim is not sufficient for its own features
gaps.finding: Pulse says every rendered value is one of 133 scalars, a banded word, or a card. Its DTOs also require event times, arrays of history samples, causal cascade steps, action IDs, coach directory records, gate outcomes, user-entered meals and evidence records that are not members of the 133 scalar list.
gaps.evidence: Pulse 00 START!A29:B29 | Pulse PDF page 1 | Pulse 05 API Contracts!A5:D15
gaps.decision: Separate the canonical projection scalars from public presentation/metadata/event/decision payloads and govern both in the signal registry.

gaps.topic: Likely stale state indices for SahaPlan Momentum/Journey
gaps.finding: Plan repeatedly cites states 195-196 as adherence/consistency/streak. The same workbook elsewhere uses the canonical lifestyle range 187-210 but does not supply a state-ID mapping. This pair must be verified against the main state vector before any binding.
gaps.evidence: Plan 03 Engine Binding!C80:C83 | Plan 03 Engine Binding!C225:C237 | Plan 09 Delta since v35.4!A10:D10
gaps.decision: Resolve by stable state_key, never numeric index alone; add CI that state_key/index mapping matches the canonical 219 registry.

gaps.topic: Pulse nutrition amount uses grams for heterogeneous nutrients
gaps.finding: tiles[].grams is declared across an 81-nutrient registry that includes kcal, liters, IU, grams, milligrams and micrograms.
gaps.evidence: Pulse 05 API Contracts!C11 | Pulse 04 Engine Binding!C18:E18
gaps.decision: Use {nutrient_id, amount, unit_code, pct_target}; enforce registry-compatible units and explicit conversions.

gaps.finding: Cascade is absent unless >=30 days and the DR interval excludes zero. The backend binding simultaneously defines High when that passes, Moderate otherwise, and absent below the gate, leaving Moderate undefined/unreachable.
gaps.evidence: Pulse 06 Backend Binding!A18:E20 | Pulse 10 Cascade+Forecast Rules!A4:B10
gaps.decision: Define separate eligibility and confidence functions. Avoid the label proven cause for observational personalized estimates; expose only a calibrated evidence status.

gaps.finding: P05 specifies three signal rows (Sleep, Meals, Movement), while P08 specifies four timeline bars (sleep window, first meal, last meal, movement). The signals[] DTO has no registry or max cardinality.
gaps.evidence: Pulse 01 Feature Ledger!A9:F9 | Pulse 01 Feature Ledger!A12:F12 | Pulse 03 Screen Specs!A9:G12 | Pulse 05 API Contracts!C6
gaps.decision: Define public rhythm_signal_id enum and exact per-screen inclusion/order.

gaps.topic: Plan HRV output contradicts its firewall
gaps.finding: Balance lens says report HF power, RMSSD and total power, but the same feature says no HRV millisecond values on T1/T2 and exposes only an undefined hrv_block.
gaps.evidence: Plan 03 Engine Binding!C325:C335
gaps.decision: For T2 expose {availability, quality, rmssd_band/trend, hf_band/trend, total_power_band/trend, as_of}; keep RR series and numeric spectral values internal unless a separately approved Tier-3 contract exists.

gaps.topic: SahaPlan buildable-now labels conflict with missing persistence and inputs
gaps.finding: Six new objects are SPEC-D/TO DECLARE/TO BUILD; burden addendum is referenced as a separate file; reward proxy is a blocker; goal relaxation is unratified; RAG namespace and 89 VETO FK rows remain open.
gaps.evidence: Plan 06 Data Objects!A16:E21 | Plan 10 Gaps & Decisions!A5:H14 | Plan 11 Build Order!A5:E16
gaps.decision: Assign readiness per signal: PRODUCTION, BASELINE_ONLY, SHADOW, SPEC_ONLY, BLOCKED, rather than per feature headline.

gaps.finding: Pulse backend binding says Low/Moderate/High; staged copy says Quiet/Moderate/Active.
gaps.evidence: Pulse 06 Backend Binding!A9:E9 | Pulse 09 Copy — Staged PC!A9:E9
gaps.decision: API should send stable codes quiet/moderate/active; client resolves approved localized copy by catalog version.

gaps.topic: Endpoint contracts lack a common response envelope
gaps.finding: Neither surface consistently carries schema_version, payload_version, as_of, computed_at, source-window, freshness state, data quality, confidence, provenance, availability/null reason or trace/correlation ID.
gaps.evidence: Pulse 05 API Contracts | Plan 05 API Contracts
gaps.decision: Require a common envelope and per-signal metadata; never infer missingness from absence alone unless omission is explicitly part of the schema.

gaps.topic: All 27 XLSX sheets are static prose
gaps.finding: Pulse contains 1,561 populated cells and Plan 2,043, but both contain zero formulas and no executable contract validation.
gaps.evidence: Artifact-tool cell/formula inventory
gaps.decision: Use the consolidated signal workbook to add machine-readable IDs, enums, cardinality, unit/cadence/freshness/provenance and executable completeness/uniqueness checks.

gaps.topic: Visual clipping and PDF glyph/layout defects
gaps.finding: Plan XLSX clips the build-rule/schema/FK rows on VETO Gate, the rule row on Data Objects and the note on Class Semantics. Pulse PDF renders the sign-off symbols as empty boxes; Plan PDF pages 5-7 use an overcompressed continuation table.
gaps.evidence: Rendered Plan sheets 04,06,08 | Pulse PDF page 4 | PlanUI PDF pages 5-7
gaps.decision: Fix source layout before using these files as handoff documents; do not rely on color/glyph alone for approval status.

gaps.finding: Twin/Plan adherence references to states 195–196 are stale.
gaps.evidence: Current P1 Variables 219 maps 195=meal_timing_reg, 196=meal_freq_smooth, 197=suppl_adherence, 198=suppl_load.
gaps.decision: Use state 197 only for supplement adherence; compute general streak from immutable event ledger, not state 196.

gaps.finding: IX·Backend & ML Specs contains an outdated POST /onboard response returning x(t0), P(t0).
gaps.evidence: Conflicts with 08 · Delivery & Firewall and thin-client rules.
gaps.decision: Return only sanitized public projection, availability, and opaque receipt; never state mean/covariance.

gaps.finding: Plan references ui_132 and leaves ui_plan TO DECLARE.
gaps.evidence: Current canonical UI projection is 133 = 1+12+12+81+12+12+3.
gaps.decision: Declare client_render.ui_plan as a separate presentation DTO referencing UI133; retire ui_132.

gaps.finding: Some UI specs suggest a gentle default when the safe action set is empty.
gaps.evidence: Contradicts fail-closed VETO-first contract.
gaps.decision: Return no action, blocked availability, and supportive non-action copy; never choose an unevaluated default.

gaps.finding: Plan requests a derived wellness band for user-entered labs.
gaps.evidence: Tier-1 examples and wellness firewall prohibit diagnostic interpretation.
gaps.decision: Expose user-entered value/unit/date/reference range as an echo plus discuss-with-professional copy only.

gaps.finding: Architecture claims approximately 50 alerts but current whitelist/blocklist defines only 25 categories.
gaps.evidence: Alert Architecture: 10 whitelist + 15 blocklist categories.
gaps.decision: Version and enumerate the remaining categories or correct the claim; do not synthesize alerts.

gaps.finding: The uploaded master filename says v39sEng, but its internal authority is v39v.
gaps.evidence: Engineer start/admission sheets and current state contract identify v39v.
gaps.decision: Use v39v as source release and preserve filename as attachment provenance.

gaps.finding: No attached workbook contains prospective real-patient outcome validation.
gaps.evidence: Validation is specification, synthetic testing, literature anchoring, or WAITING_DATA.
gaps.decision: Market as a wellness-engine specification; do not claim proven reliability, diagnosis, or clinical validation.

gaps.finding: Atlas Namespace labels HM10–HM12 conflict with the authoritative scientific hallmark list.
gaps.evidence: Canonical source is Longevity · Hallmarks; Atlas Namespace uses divergent labels for HM10–HM12.
gaps.decision: Use the Longevity · Hallmarks axis in this contract and reconcile Atlas display/catalog labels before release.

gaps.finding: P1 Variables 219 column-B variable IDs 177–200 are not state indices.
gaps.evidence: Canonical lifestyle state indices are assigned by row order as 187–210.
gaps.decision: Use explicit state_index from this registry; never infer a state index from the variable-registry ID column.

decisions.finding: Engineer split is valid but incomplete.
decisions.canonical_decision: Use roles API_OUTPUT, SERVER_INTERNAL_STATE, SERVER_INTERNAL_DERIVED, INPUT_EVENT, REFERENCE_PARAMETER and CLIENT_ROUTE_ONLY.
decisions.rationale: Prevents inputs, parameters and presentation routes being mislabeled as state/output.

decisions.finding: Scalar vs multiple values is valid but incomplete.
decisions.canonical_decision: Add ENUM/FLAG, OPAQUE_ID, TIMESTAMP, VECTOR_BY_ENTITY, TIME_SERIES, OBJECT, OBJECT_LIST, MATRIX/TENSOR and EVENT_STREAM.
decisions.rationale: Cardinality alone does not define ordering, identity, or time semantics.

decisions.finding: Do not expose every technically serializable signal.
decisions.canonical_decision: Default deny; allowlist only fields required to render approved UI.
decisions.rationale: Protects safety logic, privacy, model integrity and trade secrets.

decisions.canonical_decision: 1 composite + 12 cluster levels + 12 momentum + 81 nutrient adequacy + 12 system + 12 hallmark + 3 cell support = 133.
81 fast + 81 slow + 12 high damage + 12 low damage + 24 lifestyle + 3 glucose/insulin + 1 volume + 2 circadian + 2 body composition + 1 autonomic.
195=meal timing; 196=meal frequency; supplement adherence=197; supplement load=198; streak from event ledger.
decisions.rationale: Directly verified in current P1 Variables 219.

decisions.finding: Expose exactly three admitted support fractions.
decisions.canonical_decision: CELL01 ATP, CELL02 GSH, CELL03 NAD. Renewal remains unavailable/design-only.
127 registered, 126 activatable; action 127 is sentinel. Empty safe set yields no recommendation.

decisions.finding: Require explicit timestamps and declared normalization.
decisions.canonical_decision: Every point has timestamp; series declares window/cadence/unit/quality; no client interpolation.
Return entered value/unit/date/report reference range and supportive discuss-with-professional copy; no derived diagnosis/band.
